get.description: Returns a list of up to 300 program members on a list of values in a particular field. If you specify a filterType that is a custom field, the custom field’s dataType must be either “string” or “integer”. If you specify a filterType other than “leadId”, a maximum of 100,000 program member records can be processed by the request. Required Permissions: Read-Only Lead, Read-Write Lead

parameters.name: filterType
parameters.description: The program member field to filter on. Any custom field (string or integer types only), "updatedAt", or any searchable field. Searchable fields can be obtained via the Describe Program Member endpoint.

parameters.name: filterValues
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of values to filter on in the specified fields.

parameters.name: startAt
parameters.description: When using filterType=updatedAt, the start of date range filter (ISO 8601-format)

parameters.name: endAt
parameters.description: When using filterType=updatedAt, the end of date range filter (ISO 8601-format)

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of lead fields to return for each record.

parameters.name: batchSize
parameters.description: The batch size to return. The max and default value is 300.

parameters.name: nextPageToken
parameters.description: A token will be returned by this endpoint if the result set is greater than the batch size and can be passed in a subsequent call through this parameter. See Paging Tokens for more info.

code.description: Error code of the error. See full list of error codes here

message.description: Message describing the cause of the error

ProgramMember.description: Program member record. Always contains lead id, but may have any number of other fields, depending on the fields available in the target instance.

seq.description: Integer indicating the sequence of the record in response. This value is correlated to the order of the records included in the request input. Seq should only be part of responses and should not be submitted.

leadId.description: Unique integer id of a lead record

reachedSuccess.description: Boolean indicating if program member has reached success criteria for program

programId.description: Unique integer id of a program

acquiredBy.description: Boolean indicating if program member was acquired by program

membershipDate.description: Date the lead first became a member of the program

errors.description: Array of errors that occurred if the request was unsuccessful

moreResult.description: Boolean indicating if there are more results in subsequent pages

nextPageToken.description: Paging token given if the result set exceeded the allowed batch size

result.description: Array of results for individual records in the operation, may be empty

warnings.description: Array of warnings given for the operation
